steps.instruction: Write file skeleton. Imports: logging, datetime (datetime, timedelta, timezone), engine.base. NO database imports. Class with attributes. Methods have 'pass'. ASCII only.

Implement _relative_time(). Takes a date/datetime string (ISO format). Parse it with datetime.fromisoformat(). Calculate delta from now. Return: < 1 min -> 'just now', < 60 min -> 'N minutes ago', < 24 hours -> 'N hours ago', < 7 days -> 'N days ago', < 30 days -> 'N weeks ago', else -> 'N months ago'. Handle None input by returning 'unknown date'. Handle parse errors gracefully.

Implement execute(). Get results from request.parameters.get('results', []). If empty: return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data={'ranked': [], 'count': 0}, summary='No results to rank.', confidence=0.5, sources=['rank_by_recency']). Sort by created_at descending (most recent first). Handle missing created_at by putting those at end. Add 'relative_time' field to each result using _relative_time(). Return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data={'ranked': sorted_results, 'count': len}, summary=f'Ranked {len} results by recency. Most recent: {relative_time of first}.', confidence=0.9, sources=['rank_by_recency']). try/except.
Review. No database imports. Date parsing handles edge cases. Summary never empty. ASCII only. Production-ready.
